result.summary: The page is mostly coherent, but there is a clear text overlap in the restaurant metadata and the fixed bottom navigation obscures the next restaurant card.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar metadata line appears overlapped or duplicated around “25–30 min” and “delivery,” making the information difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Fix the metadata layout by using consistent spacing between items, preventing flex items from overlapping, and allowing the line to wrap when necessary.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation covers the lower portion of the next restaurant card image and content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page or reserve space for the navigation bar so restaurant cards are not hidden behind it.

issues.description: The horizontal category and restaurant carousels show partially clipped items at the right edge, which can look like accidental truncation if horizontal scrolling is not obvious.
issues.suggestion: Keep the carousel behavior but add a clearer scroll affordance, such as a partial-card treatment with spacing or a subtle fade/arrow indicator.
